sources.entry: Dataflare - Simple database client supporting Postgres, MySQL, DuckDB, libSQL, Cloudflare D1, and more.

summary.name: Dataflare
summary.one_liner: Dataflare is a cross-platform database manager with a graphical interface for connecting to, querying, and managing 27+ databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, DuckDB, and Redis.
use_cases: Connect to and browse multiple PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite databases in one app
Review SQL before running it to avoid accidental changes
Generate or explain SQL queries with AI assistance
Insert large volumes of random test data into a database
Query Cloudflare D1, Turso/libSQL, or R2 SQL from a desktop client
summary.what_it_does: Dataflare provides a single GUI to connect to over 27 database types, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Redis, BigQuery, Databricks, and Cloudflare D1/R2. It lets users save multiple connections and switch between them. Users can view, filter, sort, insert, update, and delete table data, and see table structures and relationships in one view. The built-in editor offers syntax highlighting, auto-complete, and real-time saving, and an optional AI feature can generate and explain SQL. It also includes a read-only style view mode and a SQL preview before execution, plus charts for analyzing data.
notable: Supports 27+ databases including cloud and edge systems like Cloudflare D1, Turso/libSQL, and S3/R2
Reviews SQL before execution to prevent unexpected changes
Built-in AI SQL generation and explanation
caveats: Paid: $0 tier is a trial-style download, Standard license is $49 for one device, Extended license is $89 for two devices
AI features are described as powered by AI; details on provider and limits are not given on the page
Platforms are not explicitly listed on the page beyond the awesome-mac listing context; macOS, Windows, and Linux are inferred from the cross-platform description
